critical_code_review_comments: BillRequests.jsx blank() correctly generates a fresh id per open (line 30-34) so FileUploader parent_id is stable within a dialog session and gets a new value each time — good.

BillRequests.jsx onProjectPicked (line 60) does NOT clear attFiles when the user switches project mid-form; if the user picks proj A, uploads, then switches to proj B, the uploaded doc(s) remain attached to the same form.id and get submitted with the final project. Not a bug for the current tests but worth documenting.

RaBills.jsx from-request effect (line 54-85) intentionally uses [] deps (empty) with eslint-disable — this means changing the URL query manually (?fromRequest=…) after mount won't re-trigger. Acceptable for the current single-shot flow but flag if future UX changes require live URL reactions.

GET /api/bill-requests returns attachment_count=None for legacy rows without the field; UI treats it as 0 correctly via (r.attachment_count || 0). Consider normalising missing/null → 0 in the backend response for consistency.
BR-2026-0003 in the listing has expected_amount=888888 but items=[] — legacy data; the new create flow always sets expected_amount = sum(items.amount) so this is safe going forward.
